instructions: Code changes go to the implementer. Always. Planning goes to the planner. Always. Cheap roles exist for side work, never as a shortcut for real work.

explorer.instructions: Read-only. Gathers codebase context, architecture, prior art, and external references. Never edits files.

planner.instructions: Owns all planning work, however small it looks.

implementer.instructions: Owns all code operations. Every repository edit goes here.

errand.instructions: Side errands only - tracker tickets, notifications, status checks, scripted browser capture. Never edits repository files. Code goes to the implementer, planning to the planner.

monitor.instructions: Owns a pull request through CI, review providers, fix loops, and merge. Verifies findings against the code, so this is judgment work, not polling.

reviewer.instructions: Must be independent of the author's model. Never dispatch a reviewer whose model matches the model that wrote the code.

plan.instructions: Reviews implementation plans before execution: spec coverage, task decomposition, interface consistency across tasks, placeholders, global constraints. Must be a different model family than the one that wrote the plan.
